title: Graded-Relevance Composed Multimodal Retrieval for E-commerce Visual Search at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2609.24152v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual search on large e-commerce catalogs must serve both "similarity" queries that ask for items resembling an uploaded image and "modifier" queries that comprise an image and text describing a desired modification (e.g. a color change or style swap). The latter is the setting known as composed image retrieval (CIR). Existing CIR methods, however, treat relevance as binary and train on triplets with a single positive target - a poor fit for real catalogs where many candidates partially satisfy a user query and ranking across that partial-match spectrum drives the customer experience. We propose a methodology for training CIR retrievers on graded relevance, consisting of: (i) a VLM to curate training data, generating both queries (object detection + modifier synthesis) and 4-level relevance labels without manual annotation, (ii) an iterative relevance-feedback loop that expands the training set by mining hard negatives from the in-train

translated_title: 面向大规模电商视觉搜索的分级相关性组合多模态检索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.24152v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大型电商商品目录上的视觉搜索必须同时服务于“相似性”查询（即要求找到与上传图片相似的商品）和“修饰词”查询（即由一张图片和一段描述期望修改的文本组成，例如颜色改变或风格替换）。后者即为组合图像检索（CIR）的场景。然而，现有的CIR方法将相关性视为二元的，并在仅含单一正样本目标的三元组上进行训练——这对于真实商品目录而言适配性很差，因为在真实目录中，许多候选商品只能部分满足用户查询，而跨部分匹配谱系的排序能力直接决定了客户体验。我们提出了一种基于分级相关性训练CIR检索器的方法，包括：(i) 使用视觉语言模型（VLM）来策划训练数据，自动生成查询（目标检测+修饰词合成）和四级相关性标签，无需人工标注；(ii) 一个迭代的相关性反馈循环，通过从训练集中挖掘困难负样本来扩展训练集……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于分级相关性训练组合图像检索模型的方法，利用视觉语言模型自动生成查询和四级相关性标签而无需人工标注，从而更好地适应电商场景中大量候选商品仅部分满足用户查询的真实情况。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a methodology for training composed image retrieval (CIR) models on graded relevance, leveraging a VLM to automatically generate queries and 4-level relevance labels without manual annotation, better fitting real e-commerce catalogs where many candidates only partially satisfy user queries.
